data.one_liner: A Flutter package providing tagging and multi-select functionality for forms.
data.what_it_does: It allows users to select, search, and add tags or labels within a form input using a customizable autocomplete-style interface. It provides widgets to configure suggestions, input text fields, and resulting item chips.
use_when: You need a tag selection or multi-select form input field.
Users need to search through suggestions and dynamically add custom tags.
avoid_when: You need simple dropdown selection without custom text searching or tagging.
strengths: Simplifies implementing tag and label selection forms.
Provides callback hooks for custom suggestions and added tags.
weaknesses: Depends on specific third-party typeahead packages that may change over time.
